rows.subtype: Approach: taking any offer without thinking [Pitfall]

rows.subtype: Approach: pricing by costs and time [Thinking]

rows.description: Excited by early earnings, the student takes on many tutoring students. Homework and sleep suffer, marks fall, and the money starts to look like a poor trade.

rows.subtype: Approach: buffer and weekly hour cap [Revision]

rows.description: The student splits earnings into three parts, family contribution, saving for a laptop and small spending, and records them in a notebook, learning the basics of budgeting through real money.

rows.subtype: Approach: learning from an unhappy customer [Revision]
rows.description: When a customer complains about a late order, the student apologises, redoes the work and begins to promise realistic delivery dates, seeing feedback as a cheap way to learn.
